title: The panel says what you picked before it explains itself
goal: Pick a rectangle, a piece of text, a measurement or a zoom callout on a laptop-sized window and the section named after that thing sits below the bottom of the panel, under Color and Effects. You have to scroll to reach the settings that only that thing has. The section named after what you picked should be readable the moment you pick it, the way the Component section now is for a copy.
notes: Measured 2026-09-06 with Scripts/playtest/dock-component-first-walk.json stage 3-ordinary-layer: viewport 688, Layers 6-257, Position & Size 257-392, Color 392-497, Effects 497-655, Rectangle 655-739. The per-kind sections (annotation, text, measure, callout) sit after color and effects in InspectorSectionID. Moving them above Effects undoes inspector.sectionOrder.version 1, which moved Effects up because Corner Radius was below the fold, so this is a genuine tradeoff and probably wants a decision card rather than a guess. The migration idiom is PanelSectionOrder.moving(_:before:in:) plus a numbered orderVersion in InspectorPanel.loadOrder.
acceptance: Picking a rectangle shows its Rectangle section whole, without scrolling, in a 1200 by 720 window
Picking a piece of text, a measurement and a zoom callout each do the same
Corner Radius stays reachable without scrolling for those same selections, which is what moving Effects up bought a month ago
A playtest walk reads the dock offsets back and proves all of the above rather than a person judging a screenshot

log.note: Adversarial review, before building. The task asks for a section reorder. Measured first with a new walk (Scripts/playtest/dock-picked-first-walk.json) on a REAL marked-up screenshot at 1200x720: a screenshot open, one measurement, four rectangles, a label and a zoom callout, so the layers list is at its full height. The dock's own offsets, viewport 688: rectangle picked -> Layers 6-257, Measurements 257-344, Position & Size 344-479, Color 479-584, Effects 584-742, Rectangle 742-826, Shadow 826-897. Text picked -> Text 749-925. Callout -> Zoom Callout 749-863. Measurement -> Measurement 674-1144.

Finding 1: the premise is worse than the task says. In this document the picked thing's section is not merely below the fold, its HEADER is off screen too, so there is no hint the section exists. And Effects is already cut: Corner Radius sits about 120pt into Effects, i.e. at 704, which is 16pt past the fold. So acceptance item 3 ('Corner Radius stays reachable, which is what moving Effects up bought') is ALREADY false as soon as the document has a measurement in it. The 2026-09-03 fix only holds on a document with nothing else in it.

Finding 2: no order can satisfy the acceptance list. One selected layer brings 890 to 1210 points of sections into a 688 point viewport, so reordering only chooses which part falls off. Worked through every permutation: with the picked section moved directly under the layers list, a rectangle and a callout fit but text loses Corner Radius (Text 176 tall + Effects 195 pushes it to 715), and the Measurement section alone is 470 tall, so Layers (251) + Measurement (470) = 721 > 688 and it can never be whole however it is ordered. Acceptance item 2 is not deliverable by a reorder at all.

Finding 3: so the real question is not 'which order' but 'the panel is over capacity, what should it do' - take you to the section named after what you picked, put it first and let something else fall off, or make room by starting the lists shorter. That is a UX call with a visible consequence either way, and the wrong guess undoes a fix the user asked for a month ago. Opening a decision.

Shipped regardless of the decision: Scripts/playtest/dock-picked-first-walk.json, which reads the dock's offsets back for all four kinds and is the harness acceptance item 4 asks for. It passes today and records the failing baseline.

Measured before building and the reorder cannot deliver: one selected layer brings 890-1210pt of sections into a 688pt panel, and the Measurement section alone is 470pt, so no order fits. Shipped Scripts/playtest/dock-picked-first-walk.json (acceptance item 4) which reads the dock offsets back for all four kinds and records the failing baseline with a real capture. Opened a decision with four options and a brief; filed a-measurement-fits-in-the-panel for the 470pt section.
decision "The properties panel holds more than fits on a laptop. What should it do when you pick something?" resolved: Put what you picked first

Decision resolved as "Put what you picked first", so built it. The sections named after the thing you picked (Rectangle/Arrow, Zoom Callout, Text, Measurement, Collage, Canvas) now sit directly under the document lists and above Position & Size, Appearance and Effects, in the same slot Component already holds. InspectorSectionID reordered; anyone with a saved order gets one numbered migration (inspector.sectionOrder.version 3) that moves the group and leaves the rest of their arrangement alone.

New pure API for it: PanelSectionOrder.moving([String], before:in:), a group move, because chaining the single move works a group backwards. Six tests in PhotonzCoreTests. Whole suite green, 4027 tests.

Made the walk PROVE rather than report: new playtest conditions sectionInView and sectionHeaderInView read the dock's own live frames, so a claim about scrolling is a step the walk fails on. Scripts/playtest/dock-picked-first-walk.json now asserts one per selection and also covers an arrow.

Measured after, viewport 688, marked-up document: text -> Text 344-520 whole; arrow -> Arrow 344-515 whole; callout -> Zoom Callout 344-458 whole; measurement -> Measurement 344-814, header on screen (was 674-1144, header off screen). Rectangle -> no Rectangle section exists any more, its outline width became a part inside Appearance when the parts list landed hours earlier, and Appearance is whole at 479-614.

Acceptance item 3 is NOT met and cannot be: clean document with a label picked, Effects 623-781, so Corner Radius sits about 743 against a 688 fold. Before the reorder it was 417-575 and reachable. This is exactly the con the chosen option carried and the user accepted it. Filed the-look-controls-come-back-above-the-fold (p3-low) to recover it without undoing the order, and a-measurement-fits-in-the-panel already covers the 470pt section.

Checked for regressions with dock-component-first, one-corner-radius, selection-effects, selection-type-and-shape, mixed-one-look and outline-width walks: all ok. In a clean document with a plain rectangle picked, Effects is still whole at 527-685, unchanged.
Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-06-picked-section-first.json, with two real window captures (Screen Recording was granted).

The section named after what you picked now sits at the top of the properties panel (InspectorSectionID reorder + one-time migration inspector.sectionOrder.version 3), in the slot Component already holds. Proven live by Scripts/playtest/dock-picked-first-walk.json with two new assert conditions (sectionInView, sectionHeaderInView): Text 344-520, Arrow 344-515, Zoom Callout 344-458 all whole in a 688pt panel; a measurement's header is on screen at 344 where it was off screen at 674; a rectangle's settings are in Appearance, whole at 479-614. 4027 tests green, 6 walks re-run clean. Acceptance item 3 (Corner Radius) is not met and cannot be: it is the tradeoff the chosen option named, and the-look-controls-come-back-above-the-fold is filed to win it back. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-06-picked-section-first.json with two real window captures.
